title: Sunrise Student Hostel
description: Affordable shared hostel near major colleges with Wi-Fi, study hall, and rooftop laundry.
fullDescription: Sunrise Student Hostel is designed for students who need a safe, budget-friendly stay close to educational hubs in Kathmandu. The property includes a study hall, hot water, reliable Wi-Fi, CCTV, and a clean rooftop laundry area.

title: Lakeside Studio Flat
description: Modern studio flat near Lakeside with balcony views and furnished interiors.
fullDescription: This studio flat in Pokhara Lakeside offers a minimal modern layout perfect for students, digital nomads, or couples. It includes a furnished bedroom area, attached kitchen, private balcony, and easy access to cafés, bus stops, and grocery stores.

title: Peaceful Family House
description: Spacious 2.5-storey home in a quiet residential area with parking and garden space.
fullDescription: A comfortable family house in Biratnagar offering multiple bedrooms, a large living area, parking, and a private garden. The neighborhood is family-friendly and close to schools, clinics, and local markets.

title: CityNest Girls Hostel
description: Secure girls hostel with biometric access, meals, and easy commute to Pulchowk campus.
fullDescription: CityNest Girls Hostel in Lalitpur provides a secure and supportive living environment for students. It offers biometric entry, meal service, housekeeping, and quick commute access to Pulchowk, Jawalakhel, and Kumaripati.

title: Heritage Courtyard Flat
description: Sunny one-bedroom flat with traditional brick exterior and modern interiors.
fullDescription: Located in the cultural heart of Bhaktapur, this one-bedroom flat blends heritage surroundings with comfortable modern living. It is ideal for professionals or small families wanting a peaceful neighborhood and quick market access.

title: Budget Bachelor Flat
description: Compact bachelor flat with private kitchen, close to public transport and supermarkets.
fullDescription: This bachelor flat is a practical option for students and young professionals in Kathmandu. It offers a private kitchen, attached bathroom, filtered water access, and a convenient location near public transport routes.

title: Terrace View House
description: Stylish family house with mountain-view terrace and covered parking.
fullDescription: A premium house in Pokhara featuring airy bedrooms, a terrace with mountain views, covered parking, and a modern kitchen. Ideal for families wanting a long-term stay with extra comfort and room to grow.

title: Pulchowk Student Flat
description: Two-room flat within walking distance of colleges, cafés, and bus stops.
fullDescription: This student-friendly flat in Lalitpur is set up for comfortable shared living with two rooms, strong Wi-Fi, bright interiors, and convenient access to educational and commercial centers.

title: Scholar Stay Hostel
description: Affordable hostel with meals, reading corner, and secure entry for students.
fullDescription: Scholar Stay Hostel is ideal for students looking for low-cost accommodation in Bhaktapur. Residents enjoy simple meals, quiet reading zones, clean washrooms, and a supportive hostel management team.

title: Modern Duplex House
description: Well-finished duplex house with four bedrooms, parking, and peaceful surroundings.
fullDescription: This modern duplex in Biratnagar offers spacious family living with four bedrooms, a stylish living room, parking, and reliable water storage. It suits mid-size families seeking a practical long-term rental.
